scripts.dev: mkdir -p out && concurrently -k -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "next dev --port 3210" "wrangler dev -c wrangler.worker.jsonc --port 8787 --test-scheduled"
scripts.build: next build && wrangler deploy worker/pages.ts -c wrangler.worker.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/pages-bundle && cp .wrangler/pages-bundle/pages.js out/_worker.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy --branch main && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply hush --local -c wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply hush --remote -c wrangler.worker.jsonc
